title: ci(zizmor): move to ubuntu-slim image
body:
This PR switches the Zizmor static-analysis workflow from `ubuntu-26.04` to the `ubuntu-slim` runner image.
Zizmor only needs a minimal environment to run its GitHub Actions security scan, so the full-sized Ubuntu runner is unnecessary. Using `ubuntu-slim` reduces resource consumption without affecting the job.        
Fixes podman-container-tools/skopeo#3007
